content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Corpus Christi

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a four-year degree with three years of project-leadership experience, or a high school diploma with five years of experience. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm you meet the education and hours requirement before enrolling in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Attend sessions at times that fit your work schedule in Oil & Gas, Port & Maritime, Healthcare, or other Corpus Christi industries. Earn your 35 required contact hours and deepen your understanding of project-management frameworks.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, apply directly to PMI with proof of your education, work experience, and course completion. Pay PMI's exam fee to officially register for the PMP exam and secure your testing window.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice questions, and instructor guidance to solidify your knowledge. Schedule your exam at a PMI-approved testing center and sit for the computerized PMP assessment when you feel ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your credential, commit to professional development during the three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or published contributions, then renew your credential before expiration to keep it active.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
